title: What Kind of Factory Will You Build?
summary: A software factory has four components: a shared context, skills & specs, an execution trace, & a curator loop that rewrites the system from the trace. Notion's A New Shape for Work & LangChain's knowledge factory describe the same loop for company knowledge. The architecture generalizes to marketing & sales factories, so the open question is what kind of factory to build.

title: The 10x Wall
summary: Anthropic & SpaceX trade at an identical 9.5x 2027 est. revenue despite 288% & 466% projected growth. Above $1t of enterprise value, public markets stop paying for top-line growth & anchor to a tight 20x to 26x earnings band.
